meta.name: 广州教科版
meta.coverage: 小学一年级至初中三年级

上.title: Unit 1 Hello
上.lesson: Hello! I am Tom. What is your name? Hi, Tom. My name is Amy. Nice to meet you!

上.title: Unit 2 Numbers
上.lesson: Let's count! One, two, three, four, five. I have five fingers on my hand. Can you count with me?

上.title: Unit 3 My Body
上.lesson: Look at me! This is my face. I have two eyes and one nose. I have a small mouth. My hair is black.

上.title: Unit 4 My Toys
上.lesson: I have many toys. I have a red car and a blue ball. My sister has a doll. We play with our toys every day.

上.title: Unit 5 Good Morning
上.lesson: Good morning, Miss Li! Good morning, class! Good afternoon, Tom! Good night, mum! Bye-bye! See you tomorrow!

下.title: Unit 1 Colors
下.lesson: Look at the rainbow! I see red, yellow, and blue. I like green. What color do you like? I like black.

下.title: Unit 2 My Family
下.lesson: This is my family. My mum, my dad and me. I have a baby sister too. I love my family. We are happy together.

下.title: Unit 3 Classroom Things
下.lesson: Look at my bag! I have a book, a pen and a pencil in it. This is my desk. That is my chair. I like my classroom.

下.title: Unit 4 I Can Sing
下.lesson: I can sing and dance. I can run and jump. Can you swim? Yes, I can! My friends and I can do many things.

下.title: Unit 5 On the Farm
下.lesson: Let's go to the farm! I can see cows and horses. I can see ducks in the water. Look! The pig is eating. I love the farm.

上.title: Unit 1 Animals
上.lesson: I have many pets. I have a cat and a dog. I also have fish and a rabbit. My cat is black. My dog is white. They are my good friends.

上.title: Unit 2 My Body
上.lesson: This is my body. I have one head and two hands. I have two feet. I have two eyes and two ears. I use my eyes to see and my ears to listen.

上.title: Unit 3 My Friends
上.lesson: I have many friends. Tom is a tall boy. Amy is a nice girl. We play together every day. We are very happy.

上.title: Unit 4 In the Park
上.lesson: Today is Sunday. We are in the park. I see many trees and colorful flowers. My brother is flying a kite. Mum is sitting on the bench.

上.title: Unit 5 My Birthday
上.lesson: Today is my birthday. I have a big cake with eight candles. My friends come to my party. They bring me many gifts. I am very happy.

下.title: Unit 1 Fruits
下.lesson: I like fruits. I like apples and bananas. My mum likes oranges. My dad likes grapes. Fruits are sweet and healthy. Do you like fruits?

下.title: Unit 2 Weather
下.lesson: Today is sunny. I am happy. Yesterday was rainy and cold. Tomorrow will be windy. I like sunny days. What's the weather like today?

下.title: Unit 3 My Pet
下.lesson: I have a little pet. It is a cute rabbit. Its name is Snow. It is white and soft. I feed it every day. I love my pet very much.

下.title: Unit 4 My Day
下.lesson: In the morning I eat breakfast and go to school. In the afternoon I have lunch and study. In the evening I play with my sister. At night I go to sleep.

下.title: Unit 5 Shopping
下.lesson: Let's go shopping! I want to buy a new hat. The shop is big. I see many nice things. I pay the money. Thank you very much!

上.title: Unit 1 School Things
上.lesson: Look at my bag. There are books, pens and pencils in it. This is my school bag. I like it very much.

上.title: Unit 2 My Classroom

words.example: The teacher writes on the blackboard.

上.lesson: This is our classroom. It is big and clean. There is a blackboard and a big window. Our teacher stands in front of the blackboard. I like my classroom.

上.title: Unit 3 My Family
上.lesson: This is my family. My father is a teacher. My mother is a doctor. I have one brother and one sister. We live with our grandpa and grandma. I love my family.

上.title: Unit 4 Numbers and Time
上.lesson: Look at the clock. It is seven o'clock. Time to get up! It is twelve o'clock now. Time for lunch. What time is it? It is nine fifteen.

上.title: Unit 5 Animals at the Zoo
上.lesson: Welcome to the zoo! I can see a big elephant. Look at the funny monkeys. The tiger is very strong. The panda is eating bamboo. I love animals.

下.title: Unit 1 My Day

words.example: I go to school by bus.

下.lesson: I get up at seven o'clock. I have breakfast at seven thirty. Then I go to school. I have lunch at twelve o'clock. I go home at five o'clock.

下.title: Unit 2 Hobbies
下.lesson: I have many hobbies. I like to play football and read books. My sister likes to sing and dance. My brother likes to draw. What are your hobbies?

下.title: Unit 3 At School
下.lesson: Our school is big and beautiful. There is a large playground and a library. We have many lessons: Chinese, math, English, music, art and PE. I love my school.

下.title: Unit 4 Buying Things
下.lesson: Can I help you? Yes, I want to buy this book. How much is it? It is 20 yuan. That's not expensive. Here is the money. Thank you!

下.title: Unit 5 Let's Eat
下.lesson: I am hungry. Can I have some bread? Yes, here you are. Thank you! I am thirsty too. Would you like milk or juice? Juice, please. Yum, it's delicious!

上.title: Unit 1 My Room

words.example: There is a bed in my room.
My desk is near the window.

上.lesson: This is my room. There is a bed, a desk and a chair in it. There is a window near the desk. I like my room very much.

上.title: Unit 2 Clothes
上.lesson: I am wearing a blue shirt and black shoes. My sister is wearing a pink dress. It is cold today, so I wear a coat and a hat. What are you wearing?

上.title: Unit 3 Weather
上.lesson: What's the weather like today? It is sunny and hot. Yesterday was cloudy and cool. Tomorrow will be rainy. I like sunny days because I can play outside.

上.title: Unit 4 Jobs
上.lesson: There are many jobs. My mother is a nurse. She helps sick people. My father is a driver. My uncle is a farmer. He grows vegetables. All jobs are important.

上.title: Unit 5 My Home
上.lesson: My home is on the third floor. It has two bedrooms, a kitchen, a bathroom and a living room with a big sofa. We also have a small garden. I love my home.

下.title: Unit 1 Food I Like
下.lesson: I like vegetables and fruit. They are healthy. I have rice and noodles too. What's your favorite food? I also like bread with milk in the morning.

下.title: Unit 2 Seasons
下.lesson: There are four seasons in a year. Spring is warm and colorful. Summer is hot and sunny. Autumn is cool. Winter is cold and snowy. My favorite season is spring.

下.title: Unit 3 Shopping for Clothes
下.lesson: Welcome! Can I help you? I want a blue shirt. What size? Medium please. Here you are. Can I try it on? Of course. How much is it? 120 yuan. Good price!

下.title: Unit 4 At the Restaurant
下.lesson: Welcome to our restaurant. Here is the menu. I would like some soup and a salad please. Would you like something to drink? Orange juice, thanks. The food is delicious!

下.title: Unit 5 My Holiday
下.lesson: Last summer holiday I went to the beach with my family. We played in the sand and swam in the sea. We also climbed a mountain. I took many beautiful photos.

上.title: Unit 1 My Dream Job

words.example: I want to be a scientist.

上.lesson: What do you want to be when you grow up? I want to be a scientist. I want to help people. My brother wants to be an engineer.

上.title: Unit 2 Travel
上.lesson: I love to travel. Last summer, I traveled to Beijing by plane. I visited the Great Wall and the Forbidden City. It was a wonderful trip. This winter, I will travel to Shanghai by train.

上.title: Unit 3 My Weekend
上.lesson: On weekends I do many things. On Saturday morning I go to the park with my friends. In the afternoon we watch a movie. On Sunday I go shopping with my mum. I also relax at home.

上.title: Unit 4 Our Country
上.lesson: China is a great country with a long history. Beijing is our capital. Our flag is red with five yellow stars. Chinese people are hardworking and kind. I am proud to be Chinese.

上.title: Unit 5 Healthy Life
上.lesson: How do we stay healthy? We should eat many vegetables and fruit. We should drink enough water. We should sleep well every night. We should also do exercise every day.

下.title: Unit 1 Protect the Earth
下.lesson: The Earth is our home. We should protect it. We should save water and plant more trees. We should not pollute rivers. Let's recycle paper and plastic to make our planet greener.

下.title: Unit 2 Sports
下.lesson: Exercise is important for our health. I play football with my classmates after school. My sister likes swimming. My father goes running every morning. What sports do you like?

下.title: Unit 3 Friends Around the World
下.lesson: I have pen pals from around the world. Lisa lives in America. She speaks English. Kenji is from Japan. He speaks Japanese. We write emails and share our lives. The world is big and wonderful.

下.title: Unit 4 Chinese Culture
下.lesson: Chinese culture has a long history. We drink tea and practice kung fu. Paper cutting is a beautiful art. Chinese calligraphy shows the beauty of words. I love my country's rich traditions.

下.title: Unit 5 Amazing Nature
下.lesson: Nature is amazing. Rivers flow through mountains. Oceans are deep and blue. Forests are full of trees and animals. We should protect nature so our planet stays beautiful.

上.title: Unit 1 How Tall Are You?
上.lesson: How tall are you, Mike? I'm 165 cm tall. I'm taller than you. How old is your brother? He is 12. He is younger than me.

上.title: Unit 2 Last Weekend
上.lesson: What did you do last weekend? I visited my grandparents. I cleaned my room and washed my clothes. It was a busy weekend.

上.title: Unit 3 Polite Words
上.lesson: Being polite is important. We say 'please' when we ask for help. We say 'thank you' when others help us. We say 'sorry' when we make a mistake.

上.title: Unit 4 Going Places
上.lesson: How do you go to school? I go by bike. My friend takes the subway. On weekends we often go to the station or airport to travel. Public transport is convenient in our city.

上.title: Unit 5 Science Fair
上.lesson: Last week we had a science fair at school. My classmate did an interesting experiment with magnets. I made a small windmill. The teacher said our projects were great. I learned many new things.

下.title: Unit 1 Chinese Festivals
下.lesson: China has many festivals. Spring Festival is the most important. We eat dumplings and hang red lanterns. Mid-Autumn Festival is also fun. We look at the bright moon and eat mooncakes.

下.title: Unit 2 My Future
下.lesson: I often think about my future. I want to go to a good college. I will study hard every day. My parents tell me that hard work is important. I believe I can achieve success.

下.title: Unit 3 My Best Friend
下.lesson: My best friend is Lisa. She is kind, funny and helpful. We always study together and share our snacks. When I have problems, she helps me. A good friend is a real treasure.

下.title: Unit 4 Saving Water
下.lesson: Water is very precious. Without water no life can exist. We should not waste water. Close the tap when you brush your teeth. Take short showers. Every drop counts.

上.title: Unit 1 My Diary

words.example: I keep a diary every day.

上.lesson: Today is Sunday. The weather is sunny. I went to the library in the morning. I read books there. In the afternoon, I played basketball with my friends.

上.title: Unit 2 School Life
上.lesson: At school, I have many subjects. I study Chinese, English, math, science and history. My favorite subject is English because I love learning new languages. What is your favorite subject?

上.title: Unit 3 Making Friends
上.lesson: Starting junior high, I met many new classmates. We introduced ourselves and shared our hobbies. Making friends is not hard. Just be kind, confident and ready to communicate. A good friendship lasts a lifetime.

上.title: Unit 4 Healthy Lifestyle
上.lesson: A healthy lifestyle is important for teenagers. We should avoid too much junk food and eat balanced meals. Regular exercise keeps us fit. Going to bed early and getting up early are good habits. Health comes first.

下.title: Unit 1 Environment
下.lesson: Our environment is very important. We need clean air and clean water. We should not throw garbage on the street. Everyone can help to make our city more beautiful.

下.title: Unit 2 Technology
下.lesson: Modern technology has changed our lives. We use computers and phones every day. We can send emails and shop online. The internet connects us to the world. Technology makes our lives easier and more fun.

下.title: Unit 3 Learning English
下.lesson: Learning English needs time and practice. Grammar helps us make correct sentences. A big vocabulary helps us express ideas. Don't be afraid of making mistakes. Every mistake is a chance to improve.

下.title: Unit 4 Online Safety
下.lesson: The internet is useful but we must stay safe. Don't share your password. Don't tell strangers your personal information. Tell your parents if something strange happens online. Be smart and stay safe.

上.title: Unit 1 What's the matter?

words.example: Take the medicine three times a day.

上.lesson: What's the matter, Tom? I have a bad cold and a headache. You should drink hot water and take some medicine. Thank you for your advice.

上.title: Unit 2 Hobbies
上.lesson: Reading is a good hobby. It can help you learn many things. You can read at home, in the library or in the park. Reading makes you smart.

上.title: Unit 3 Books I Love
上.lesson: My favorite book is 'Harry Potter'. J.K. Rowling is the author. The main character Harry is brave and kind. The story takes us to a magical world. I recommend it to everyone who loves imagination.

上.title: Unit 4 Social Manners
上.lesson: Good manners show our respect for others. We should say please and thank you. We should queue up in public places. If we make mistakes, we should apologize. Good behavior makes our society more pleasant.

下.title: Unit 1 Volunteering
下.lesson: Last Saturday, I worked as a volunteer in my community. We helped clean the park and visited the elderly. It felt good to help others. I learned that volunteering makes our community better and makes us happier.

下.title: Unit 2 My Hometown
下.lesson: My hometown is Guangzhou. It is a beautiful and modern city. We have tall buildings and old traditional houses. The food is very delicious. I love my hometown very much and I am proud to live here.

下.title: Unit 3 My School Life
下.lesson: I love my school life. Every morning we wear our uniforms and have classes together with our classmates. We have lunch at the canteen. After school, I join the music club. School life is busy but full of fun.

下.title: Unit 4 Kindness Matters
下.lesson: Small kindness can change the world. Last month our class donated clothes and books to an orphanage. The children there were happy and grateful. Kindness gives people hope. Let's be kind to everyone we meet.

上.title: Unit 1 Famous Places
上.lesson: The Great Wall is one of the most famous places in China. It is about 21196 kilometers long. It is a wonder of the world. Many people visit it every year.

上.title: Unit 2 Inventions
上.lesson: Inventions have changed our world. The light bulb was invented by Thomas Edison. It changed the way we live. The telephone was invented by Alexander Bell. Today, we enjoy many useful inventions in our daily lives.

上.title: Unit 3 Music and Life
上.lesson: Music plays an important role in our lives. It expresses different emotions and connects people from all over the world. Many students learn instruments like the piano or violin. Going to concerts is also a wonderful experience.

上.title: Unit 4 Chinese Heritage
上.lesson: China has a rich cultural heritage. The Forbidden City, the Great Wall and ancient temples are treasures that tell our long history. They belong not only to China, but also to the world. We must protect them for future generations.

下.title: Unit 1 Future Plans
下.lesson: In the future, I plan to go to a good university. I want to major in computer science because I love technology. After graduation, I hope to start my own company. I will work hard to achieve my dreams.

下.title: Unit 2 Global Issues
下.lesson: Our world faces many global issues today. Global warming affects our weather. Many children in poor countries need education. We all hope for peace and a better world. Each of us can make a small difference.

下.title: Unit 3 Environmental Action
下.lesson: Protecting the environment is everyone's responsibility. We should reduce pollution and recycle waste. Using renewable energy like solar power is a great idea. Small actions in daily life, like saving electricity, can make a big difference.

下.title: Unit 4 Science and Technology
下.lesson: Science and technology are changing our lives quickly. Artificial intelligence and robots help us in many ways. We explore space and make new discoveries every year. Technology brings great benefits, but we must use it wisely.
